name: Medicare Appointment Follow-Up Emails
description: Triggered by Fireflies webhook when a transcript is ready. Fetches full transcript with AI summary, looks up the Calendly booking by client email, formats a follow-up email via Claude, and sends it to both the client and agent.

flow.label: Fireflies Webhook Trigger
flow.description: Fires when Fireflies sends a 'Transcription completed' webhook. Payload field {{1.meetingId}} is the Fireflies transcript ID.

flow.label: Get Transcript + AI Summary
flow.description: Fetches full transcript data including AI summary, action items, participants, and transcript URL.

mapper.queryBody: query GetTranscript($id: String!) { transcript(id: $id) { id title date participants host_email organizer_email transcript_url summary { action_items keywords overview shorthand_bullet } } }

flow.label: Look Up Calendly Booking
flow.description: Searches Calendly for the most recent booking for this client by email. Returns appointment type name and scheduled time.

flow.label: Format Email with Claude
flow.description: Sends Fireflies summary + action items to Claude Sonnet 4.6. Output is a complete warm email body ready to send.

flow.label: Send Email to Client
flow.description: Sends the formatted follow-up email to the client. Requires a Gmail connection (google-email type) — must be added manually in Make.

flow.label: Send Recap Copy to Agent
flow.description: Sends the same formatted email plus the Fireflies transcript link to tim@foundersinsuranceagency.com. Requires Gmail connection.
